title: Daily 5, Wed 25 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: If x : y = 3 : 5, what is (2x + y) : (x + 2y)?
A shop runs a "buy 3, get 1 free" offer on soap. What discount does a customer get on the 4 bars, as a percentage?
A train 240 m long passes completely through a platform 360 m long in 30 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
4 chairs and 3 tables cost ₹9,600. 2 chairs and 5 tables cost ₹11,800. What does one table cost, in rupees?
How many positive integers n satisfy both 2n + 5 ≤ 31 and 3n − 4 > 20?
